gateway.description: The SIP/CTI gateway this adapter drives.

app_name.description: The Stasis application the Asterisk dialplan hands calls to (ARI).

credentials_secret_ref.description: Reference into the secret store for the gateway API user/password (E13-07). Never inline credentials — this is the deployment path that uses ADR-0019.

credentials.description: Inline API user/password for a dev / CI / file-provisioned instance ONLY. Production stores these in the DB, encrypted at rest (ADR-0033).

lines.description: Logical BBZ line ids this instance owns (endpoint defaults to PJSIP/<line>).

line_endpoints.description: Explicit BBZ line id -> Asterisk endpoint map (overrides the PJSIP/<line> default). Production fills this from the DB (ADR-0033).

dtmf_transport.description: On-the-wire transport for send_dtmf (E13-06). The DTMF sequence is resolved and held by BBZ (ADR-0025); this adapter only emits it.
